author: No back iteam event
title: Please Don’t Bring Back Old Elite Pass & Rare Items Again
content:
Subject: Please Don’t Bring Back Old Elite Pass & Rare Items Again

Dear Garena Free Fire Team,

I hope you read this message not only as developers, but also as people who understand emotions and memories.

For many players like me, old Elite Pass items, rare bundles, and classic rewards are not just pixels inside a game. They are memories of our childhood, late-night matches with friends, old squads that no longer play together, and the happiest moments we spent in Free Fire.

Back then, we waited every month for new Elite Passes with excitement. Some of us saved money for weeks just to buy a pass or a rare bundle. Some items became special because they represented a specific time in our lives — a time we can never get back.

When very old and rare items return again and again, it hurts the emotional value attached to them. The rarity disappears, but more importantly, the feeling connected to those memories slowly fades away.

Old players stayed loyal to Free Fire for years because those rare collections felt meaningful and personal. Seeing those exclusive items return makes many veteran players feel like their long-time support and dedication no longer matter.

Please understand that rarity creates emotion.
Exclusivity creates memories.
And memories are what make a game truly special.

Not every item needs to return. Some things should remain as symbols of the old Free Fire era — for the players who were there from the beginning and supported the game through every season.

We are not writing this message with anger.
We are writing it with love, nostalgia, and respect for the game that gave us unforgettable memories.

Free Fire is more than a game to many of us.
It is a part of our life story.

Please protect the value and emotion of old Elite Passes and rare bundles.

Thank you for listening.

Sincerely,
A Loyal Free Fire Player ❤️

author: Cr-Kay2539
title: Improving the game
content:
Free Fire is fun, but it feels too casual and a bit cartoon-like for mature players.

Evo gun scopes feel the same as normal scopes, which makes them less special. Unique visuals or effects would make them more exciting.

Also, while flashy emotes are cool, more realistic characters and skins would help the game appeal to older players.

A more serious ranked system, better matchmaking, and less grind would make the game feel more competitive and rewarding.

The game has great potential, but adding more depth and a realistic option would improve it a lot.
